unit_text: The second question was whether accuracy would hold at a centre whose reports played no part in prompt development. At centre B the model reached an accuracy of 95.8% (95% CI 93.9 to 97.5), close to the 96.3% of the combined test set. Clinical text models often lose accuracy when moved between hospitals because templates, abbreviations and grading habits differ [@vandermeer2024external]. The small difference between centres suggests that the prompt did not depend on the reporting habits of centre A, where it was developed. Because both centres are Swiss university hospitals, this result supports transfer between similar hospitals rather than across health systems.
